transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our material-handling sync going. We've got one 10,000-pound forklift available from 0800 through 1200 tomorrow, and two scheduled movements: unloading refrigerated medical pallets and moving engineering barrier pallets. Before I publish the final schedule, I need the distribution and motor-pool representatives to confirm timing, location, and equipment-control requirements for both movements. Who wants to start?
